RDI Railing expands distribution network with industry partners
November 12, 2026 | 9:32 am CST
RDI Railing expands distribution network with industry partners
The expansion strengthens RDI's presence across key markets in the Southeast, Northeast, Midwest and West. Photo by RDI.

ATLANTA — RDI Railing, the premium railing brand from Oldcastle APG, announced the expansion of its strong existing distribution network with 34 new locations across the United States through new or expanded relationships with Weyerhaeuser, Palmer-Donavin, BlueLinx, Woodgrain Distribution and Manufacturers Reserve Supply (MRS).

"Expanding access to our products is an important part of how we support our customers and partners," said Chris Hayn, EVP for RDI Railing. "By growing alongside trusted distributors, we're able to bring RDI products closer to the professionals who use them while providing the local availability and support they need to keep projects moving."
The expanded distribution footprint includes 34 new stocking locations through five of RDI's distribution partners:

Weyerhaeuser
RDI is expanding its distribution footprint with Weyerhaeuser by adding 11 locations across the Southeast and West:

Gallatin, Tennessee
Jacksonville, Florida
Dacula, Georgia
Tacoma, Washington
Spokane, Washington
Albany, Oregon
Billings, Montana
Denver, Colorado
Dallas, Texas
Houston, Texas
San Antonio, Texas

RDI introduces its relationship with Palmer-Donavin by adding 10 locations across the Midwest and Southeast. Palmer-Donavin is a 100% employee-owned distributor of residential building materials serving customers across the Midwest, Mid-Atlantic and Southeast.

Lansing, Michigan
Bluffton, Indiana
Hebron, Kentucky
Grove City, Ohio
North Jackson, Ohio
Richmond, Virginia
Knoxville, Tennessee
Raleigh, North Carolina
Duncan, South Carolina
Darlington, South Carolina

BlueLinx
Five additional BlueLinx locations will expand access to RDI products across Northeast and Central U.S. markets:

Bellingham, Massachusetts
Burlington, Vermont
Portland, Maine
Tulsa/Broken Arrow, Oklahoma
Omaha, Nebraska

Woodgrain Distribution
RDI is also adding seven locations through Woodgrain Distribution, expanding product availability across additional Western and Central markets:

Auburn, Washington
Tigard, Oregon
Houston, Texas
Cape Girardeau, Missouri
Jackson, Mississippi
Salt Lake City, Utah
Boise, Idaho

RDI is also introducing a relationship with Manufacturers Reserve Supply (MRS), including distribution coverage for Connecticut, Delaware, Eastern New York, excluding Long Island, Eastern Pennsylvania, Massachusetts, & Rhode Island. MRS's distribution center is located in Irvington, New Jersey.
Together, the new locations expand RDI's geographic reach and provide dealers and contractors with additional points of access to its portfolio of railing solutions.

"Our distributor relationships are central to strengthening the connection between our products and the professionals who rely on RDI every day," added Hayn. "RDI offers solutions that combine versatile design, lasting performance and simplified installation for residential and commercial applications. With an expanded distribution network, customers will benefit not only from greater product availability, but also from enhanced local service and support."
For more information about RDI Railing and its portfolio of railing solutions, visit RDI Railing.
